schemaClass.name: Action
schemaClass.description: An Action entity specifies the mechanism by which inputs are transformed into outputs.

schemaProperty.name: Percent Complete
schemaProperty.description: Percent Complete represents the percentage this Action is complete.

schemaProperty.name: Start
schemaProperty.description: Start represents the time when this Action begins.

schemaProperty.name: Duration
schemaProperty.description: Duration represents the period of time this Action occurs.

schemaClass.name: Artifact
schemaClass.description: An Artifact entity specifies a document or other source of information that is referenced by or generated in the knowledgebase.

schemaProperty.name: Date Published
schemaProperty.description: Date Published represents the date when this Artifact was accessed (webpage), published, or uploaded to the knowledgebase.

schemaProperty.name: File
schemaProperty.description: The File that represents this Artifact.

schemaClass.name: Asset
schemaClass.description: An Asset entity specifies an object, person, or organization that performs Actions, such as a system, subsystem, component, or element.

schemaClass.name: Resource
schemaClass.description: A Resource entity specifies a consumable or producible Asset.

schemaProperty.name: Units
schemaProperty.description: Units represents this Resource's units used to measure the amounts, such as each or tons.

schemaProperty.name: Initial Amount
schemaProperty.description: Initial Amount represents this Resource's starting amount.

schemaProperty.name: Minimum Amount
schemaProperty.description: Minimum Amount represents this Resource's minimum amount allowed.

schemaProperty.name: Maximum Amount
schemaProperty.description: Maximum Amount represents this Resource's maximum amount allowed.

schemaClass.name: Port
schemaClass.description: An interaction point of a block, specifying the input and output flow.

schemaProperty.name: Direction
schemaProperty.description: Direction represents the flow of data on this port.

schemaClass.name: Characteristic
schemaClass.description: A Characteristic entity specifies properties of an entity.

schemaProperty.name: Value
schemaProperty.description: Value represents this Characteristic's current value.

schemaProperty.name: Units
schemaProperty.description: Units represents this Characteristic's units used to measure the value, such as pounds or miles per hour.

schemaClass.name: Measure
schemaClass.description: A Measure entity specifies properties of measurements and measuring methodologies, including metrics.

schemaProperty.name: Projected Value
schemaProperty.description: Projected Value represents this Measure's expected value to be achieved with existing resources.

schemaProperty.name: Threshold Value
schemaProperty.description: Threshold Value represents the minimum acceptable value for this Measure.

schemaProperty.name: Objective Value
schemaProperty.description: Objective Value represents the goal for this Measure.

schemaProperty.name: Improvement Direction
schemaProperty.description: Improvement Direction represents the direction in that metric improvement occurs. It is the direction from the Threshold Value to the Objective Value.

schemaProperty.name: Tolerance
schemaProperty.description: Tolerance represents the percentage of the value that forms the positive and negative tolerance bands. Tolerance is used when Value represents the planned measure value at a given time.

schemaClass.name: Connection
schemaClass.description: A Connection entity specifies the mechanism relating Assets. This is an abstract class.

schemaClass.name: Conduit
schemaClass.description: A Conduit entity specifies the connection between Assets and has capacity and latency, which carries an Input/Output.

schemaProperty.name: Capacity
schemaProperty.description: Capacity represents the maximum rate supported by the Conduit. (Used in simulation as to add time delay by dividing the Input/Output size with the capacity value.)

schemaProperty.name: Latency
schemaProperty.description: Latency represents the time required to transmit the information or Input/Output entity over this Conduit. This value does not factor in any delays due to capacity limitations.

schemaProperty.name: Units
schemaProperty.description: Units represents this Conduit's units used to measure the capacity, such as bits per second or gallons per minute.

schemaClass.name: Logical
schemaClass.description: A Logical entity specifies relationship between Assets. It is primarily used in database schema development and entity-relationship diagrams.

schemaClass.name: Cost
schemaClass.description: A Cost entity specifies the outlay or expenditure (as of effort or sacrifice) made to achieve an objective associated with another entity.

schemaProperty.name: Amount
schemaProperty.description: Amount represents this Cost's value.

schemaProperty.name: Units
schemaProperty.description: Units represents this Cost's units used to measure the amount, such as $ or Euro.

schemaProperty.name: Rate
schemaProperty.description: Rate represents this Cost's billing rate.

schemaProperty.name: Category
schemaProperty.description: Category represents the part of the lifecycle for which the money is used (commonly called Color of Money). This matches the Federal Government (DoD) cost phases.

schemaProperty.name: Contract Type
schemaProperty.description: Contract Type represents this Cost way to identify the reimbursement structure (i.e. CPFF vs T&M).

schemaClass.name: Decision
schemaClass.description: A Decision entity specifies a challenge and its resolution.

schemaProperty.name: Justification
schemaProperty.description: Justification represents the reason and context for making this Decision.

schemaProperty.name: Assumptions
schemaProperty.description: Assumptions represents facts that are used as a basis for this Decision. These assumptions can be taken for granted by the decision maker.

schemaClass.name: Equation
schemaClass.description: An Equation entity specifies an equation (mathematical or logical) that can be used to describe a part of the model.

schemaProperty.name: Value
schemaProperty.description: Value represents this Equation's text.

schemaClass.name: Input/Output
schemaClass.description: An Input/Output entity specifies the information, data, or object input to, triggers, or output from an Action.

schemaProperty.name: Size
schemaProperty.description: Size represents the amount or proportion of this Input/Output, such as 100 as in 100 Gigabytes or number of entities (e.g. 10 as in 10 tokens).

schemaProperty.name: Units
schemaProperty.description: Units represents this Input/Output's units used to measure the size, such as Gigabyte or tokens.

schemaClass.name: Issue
schemaClass.description: An Issue entity specifies a bug, user story, or an epic.

schemaProperty.name: Status
schemaProperty.description: Status represents the current state of this Issue.

stringAttribute.value: Open

schemaProperty.name: Assignee
schemaProperty.description: Assignee represents the user(s) and/or team(s) responsible for the issue.

schemaProperty.name: Priority
schemaProperty.description: Priority represents the level of effect this issue is causing.

stringAttribute.value: Moderate

schemaClass.name: Location
schemaClass.description: A Location entity specifies where an entity resides.

schemaClass.name: Orbital
schemaClass.description: An Orbital entity specifies a location along an orbit around a celestial body.

schemaProperty.name: Apoapsis
schemaProperty.description: Apoapsis represents the point of greatest distance from the celestial body being orbited. For Earth, the term is apogee. For the Sun the term commonly used is aphelion. The Apoapsis must be specified with the Periapsis to characterize the orbital ellipse shape.

schemaProperty.name: Periapsis
schemaProperty.description: Periapsis represents the point of closest distance from the celestial body being orbited. For Earth, the term is perigee. For the Sun the term commonly used is perihelion. The Periapsis must be specified with the Apoapsis to characterize the orbital ellipse shape.

schemaProperty.name: Eccentricity
schemaProperty.description: Eccentricity represents the amount the orbit deviates from a perfect circle (0 being perfectly circular and 1 is a parabola - no longer a closed orbit). The Eccentricity must be specified with the Semimajor axis to characterize the orbital ellipse shape.

schemaProperty.name: Semimajor Axis
schemaProperty.description: Semimajor Axis represents the one half of the length of the longest diameter of the orbital ellipse. The Semimajor axis must be specified with the Eccentricity to characterize the orbital ellipse shape.

schemaProperty.name: Inclination
schemaProperty.description: Inclination represents the angle between the orbital plane and a reference plane, such as the equatorial plane for Earth. The Inclination must be specified with the Longitude of Ascending Node to characterize the orbital plane.

schemaProperty.name: Reference Plane
schemaProperty.description: Reference Plane represents the reference plane from where the Inclination angle will be calculated.

schemaProperty.name: Longitude of Ascending Node
schemaProperty.description: Longitude of Ascending Node represents the angle from the Origin of Longitude to the ascending node, measured in the Reference Plane. For the Earth, the origin of longitude is typically the Prime Meridian. The Longitude of Ascending Node must be specified with the Inclination to characterize the orbital plane.

schemaProperty.name: Origin of Longitude
schemaProperty.description: Origin of Longitude represents the reference meridian from where the Longitude of Ascending Node will be calculated.

schemaProperty.name: Argument of Periapsis
schemaProperty.description: Argument of Periapsis represents the angle between the Periapsis and the ascending node as measured in the orbital plane in the direction of motion.

schemaProperty.name: Mean Anomaly
schemaProperty.description: Mean Anomaly represents the proportion of orbital area swept since the last Periapsis at the specified time. It is used to define the position of the orbiting Asset along the orbital ellipse.

schemaClass.name: Physical
schemaClass.description: A Physical entity specifies a location on or above the surface.

schemaProperty.name: Address
schemaProperty.description: Address represents this Location's complete address.

schemaProperty.name: Coordinates
schemaProperty.description: Coordinates represents the coordinate points for this Location (GPS or other system).

schemaProperty.name: Altitude
schemaProperty.description: Altitude represents the distance above the surface.

schemaClass.name: Virtual
schemaClass.description: A Virtual entity specifies a location within a digital network.

schemaProperty.name: Address
schemaProperty.description: Address represents the identification address using the Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) protocols.

schemaClass.name: Risk
schemaClass.description: A Risk entity specifies the combined probability and consequence in achieving objectives.

schemaProperty.name: Consequence Description
schemaProperty.description: Consequence Description represents the result of this Risk occurring.

schemaProperty.name: Consequence
schemaProperty.description: Consequence represents the level of effect from this Risk occurring.

schemaProperty.name: Probability
schemaProperty.description: Probability represents the chance that this Risk will occur.

schemaProperty.name: Status
schemaProperty.description: Status represents the current state of this Risk.

stringAttribute.value: Open

schemaClass.name: Statement
schemaClass.description: A Statement entity specifies text referenced by the knowledgebase and usually contain in an Artifact.

schemaClass.name: Requirement
schemaClass.description: A Requirement entity identifies a capability, characteristic, or quality factor of a system that must exist for the system to have value and utility to the user.

schemaProperty.name: Rationale
schemaProperty.description: Rationale provides a place to capture the reason(s) behind this Requirement.

schemaProperty.name: Status
schemaProperty.description: Status represents the current state of this Requirement.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

schemaProperty.name: Quality Score
schemaProperty.description: The calculated quality score.

schemaProperty.name: Appropriate
schemaProperty.description: Appropriate represents if this Requirement expresses the specific intent and amount of detail of the need or requirement statement appropriate to the level (the level of abstraction, organization, or system architecture) of the entity to which it refers.

schemaProperty.name: Complete
schemaProperty.description: Complete represents if this Requirement sufficiently describes the necessary capability, characteristic, constraint, or quality factor to meet the need, source, or parent requirement from which it was transformed without needing other information to understand the requirement.

schemaProperty.name: Conforming
schemaProperty.description: Conforming represents if the Requirement is conforming to an approved standard pattern and style guide or standard for writing and managing needs and requirements.

schemaProperty.name: Correct
schemaProperty.description: Correct represents if this Requirement is an accurate representation of the need, source, or parent requirement from which it was transformed.

schemaProperty.name: Feasible
schemaProperty.description: Feasible represents if this Requirement can be realized within entity constraints with acceptable risk.

schemaProperty.name: Necessary
schemaProperty.description: Necessary represents if this Requirement defines an essential capability, characteristic, constraint, or quality factor needed to satisfy a lifecycle concept, need, source, or parent requirement.

schemaProperty.name: Verifiable
schemaProperty.description: Verifiable represents if this Requirement is provable (within realistic cost and schedule) that the system meets the requirement.

schemaProperty.name: Singular
schemaProperty.description: Singular represents if this Requirement states a single capability, characteristic, constraint, or quality factor.

schemaProperty.name: Unambiguous
schemaProperty.description: Unambiguous represents if this Requirement is stated such that the requirement can be interpreted in only one way by all the intended stakeholders.

schemaClass.name: Time
schemaClass.description: A Time entity specifies a point or period when something occurs or during which an action, asset, process, or condition exists or continues.

schemaProperty.name: Start
schemaProperty.description: Start represents the time when this Time begins.

schemaProperty.name: Duration
schemaProperty.description: Duration represents the period of time this Time occurs.

schemaClass.name: Test Case
schemaClass.description: A Test Case entity represents a set of conditions utilized to determine whether a system works as intended.

schemaProperty.name: Set Up
schemaProperty.description: Set Up represents the prerequisites that must be fulfilled before executing this Test Case.

schemaProperty.name: Expected Result
schemaProperty.description: Expected Result represents the result expected when executing this Test Case.

schemaProperty.name: Actual Result
schemaProperty.description: Actual Results represents the results that are captured after executing a Test Case.

schemaProperty.name: Status
schemaProperty.description: Status represents the current state of this Test Case.

schemaClass.name: Task
schemaClass.description: A Task entity specifies an Action that must be completed for a particular project. It served as a "To-Do" for the Project.

schemaClass.name: Dependency
schemaClass.description: A Dependency entity specifies a connection between two Tasks in a Gantt Chart. It defines the relationship a Task depends on another Task in order to Start or Finish

schemaClass.name: Transition
schemaClass.description: A Transition entity specifies an action that, once completed, transitions one state (Characteristic) to another state (Characteristic).

label.name: Independent Verification & Validation Plan Document
label.description: Independent approach to verification and validation (IV&V) Plan documents the approach and processes that will be used to ensure that an independent approach to the verification and validation is incorporated into the project from the beginning of the lifecycle through implementation.

label.name: Test Plan Document
label.description: The Test Plan document documents and tracks the necessary information required to effectively define the approach to be used in the testing of the project's product.

label.name: Integrated Logistics Support Plan Document
label.description: The Integrated Logistics Support Plan (ILSP) serves as the master logistics planning document that describes necessary logistic activities, assigns responsibility for those activities, and establishes a schedule for completion.

label.name: Standard Operating Procedure Document
label.description: A Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) is a set of step by step instructions for carrying out a specific technique. They can be used for any technique, but this guide focuses on their use in documenting monitoring techniques, specifically for species and ecological communities.

label.name: Concept of Operations Document
label.description: The Concept of Operations Document (CONOPS) is both an analysis and a formal document that describes how an asset, system, or capability will be employed and supported.

label.name: Requirements Document
label.description: The Requirements Document provides the stakeholders with a clear statement of the capabilities required of the system in order to solve the stakeholder's needs.

label.name: Simulation Output
label.description: Is the dashboard from an executed simulation.

label.name: Project Management Plan Document
label.description: The Project Management Plan (PMP) is a formal document used to document planning assumptions and decisions, facilitate communication among staekholders, and document approved scope, cost, and schedule baslines.

label.name: Final State
label.description: A UML State Machine's final state.

label.name: Initial State
label.description: A UML State Machine's initial state.

label.name: Report
label.description: System generated reports contain this label.

stringAttribute.value: All submitted availability intervals are accepted and represented correctly without omission.
Prepare several valid availability intervals covering different days and times.

entity.name: N-06 keep saved data available
entity.description: Students need their saved tasks and availability to remain available between sessions, because re-entering information discourages continued use.

entity.name: Verify Traceability and Scope Control
entity.description: Inspect the requirement traceability structure and verify that system requirements remain linked to approved stakeholder requirements and project scope.

stringAttribute.value: Applicable system requirements have valid trace relationships and remain within the approved StudyFlow scope.
Review the stakeholder requirements, system requirements, and existing trace relationships in Innoslate.

entity.name: Verify Development Maintenance Interface
entity.description: Inspect the Development / Support interface and verify that maintenance and configuration interactions are clearly defined.

stringAttribute.value: System updates, configuration changes, maintenance, and support interactions are explicitly defined.

entity.name: Support Browser-Based Planning
entity.description: The Feasible Plan Generation Subsystem shall support study-plan generation through the system's desktop web-browser workflow without requiring the student to install additional client-side software.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

Equivalence is selected to carry the no-client-installation constraint in system requirement 2.3.3 to the planning subsystem. The subsystem must remain compatible with the browser-based deployment concept. This requirement does not prescribe whether planning executes in the browser or on a server.

entity.name: Identify Scheduling Constraints
entity.description: The Scheduling Constraint Module shall identify the scheduling constraints applicable to the prioritized task set.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

Scheduling constraints must be identified before available study slots can be determined and prioritized tasks can be allocated, ensuring that downstream planning remains consistent with the feasible-plan-generation responsibility of F.1.5.

entity.name: Academic Task Data Subsystem to Deadline and Workload Analysis Subsystem
Browser Platform
entity.description: The StudyFlow system shall operate in a current version of a standard desktop web browser without requiring client-side software installation.

stringAttribute.value: Draft
The Deployment Concept defines StudyFlow as a browser-based web application; an installation step would add effort for first-time students.

qualityAttribute.suggestion: Please resolve issues found with the Complete, Singular, and/or Unambiguous attributes.
R5 - Contains indefinite article(s): [a, a]. Consider replacing with the definite article, "the."

entity.name: Perform StudyFlow System Mission
entity.description: StudyFlow system mission: transform student-entered academic task data and study availability into an actionable rule-based study plan and prioritized next-task recommendation, and update the plan when saved inputs change. The system internal first-level decomposition consists of F.1.1 Receive and Maintain Academic Task Data, F.1.2 Capture Study Availability, F.1.3 Analyze Deadlines and Workload, F.1.4 Calculate Task Priorities, F.1.5 Generate Feasible Study Plan, and F.1.6 Update and Present Study Plan. F.2 through F.6 are external participant functions in the Metafunction context. The Student-facing planning-output package includes workload shortfall by task in minutes and on-page notifications; scheduled smart reminders remain outside the MVP scope.

entity.name: LLM Service
entity.description: 一种外部语言模型服务，通过生成自然语言解释、建议或其他人工智能辅助学习指导来支持StudyFlow。

entity.name: Verify Study Assistance Request Output
entity.description: Inspect the optional LLM interface specification and verify that the Study Assistance Request and Context for study-planning assistance are explicitly and consistently defined.

stringAttribute.value: The Study Assistance Request and Context are consistently named and defined in requirement 1.2.5 and the F.6 interface. The request supports optional study-planning assistance; the core rule-based MVP remains operable without the LLM Service.
Review the LLM request/interface specification.

entity.name: Provide study plans, task-priority recommendations, on-page notifications, plan updates, and workload shortfall
entity.description: The StudyFlow System shall provide study plans, task-priority recommendations, plan updates, and on-page notifications to the Student. On-page notifications shall report the result of plan generation or update and identify unscheduled workload by task in minutes when the Student's supplied availability is insufficient. Scheduled smart reminders and external push, email, or SMS notifications are outside the current MVP scope.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

qualityAttribute.suggestion: R30 - Potential duplicate of: [1.3.1 Planning outputs and workload shortfall (84.8% similar)]

stringAttribute.value: Study plans and priority recommendations give students actionable guidance on what to work on, when to work on it, and how the plan changes as inputs change.

qualityAttribute.suggestion: Please resolve issues found with the Complete, Singular, and/or Unambiguous attributes.

entity.name: Course information, assignments, exams, deadlines, grades (optional)
Support Independent Planning Tests
entity.description: The Feasible Plan Generation Subsystem shall expose documented input and output interfaces that allow its planning logic to be tested without the user interface or persistent data store.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

Equivalence is selected because system requirement 2.1.2 explicitly requires planning logic to be tested independently of the user interface and persistent data store. The same independence constraint applies directly to the Feasible Plan Generation Subsystem.

entity.name: Receive Prioritized Task Set
entity.description: The Feasible Plan Generation Subsystem shall receive the Prioritized Task Set for study-plan generation.

stringAttribute.value: Draft
The Prioritized Task Set crosses the subsystem boundary and supplies the input used to identify scheduling constraints.

entity.name: Data Privacy
entity.description: The StudyFlow system shall disclose a student's academic task and availability records only to that student under the documented user-access model.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

qualityAttribute.suggestion: R26 - Potential use of absolutes detected: [only]

stringAttribute.value: Exposed academic or schedule data would cause students to stop trusting the tool; 1.1.7 accepts the privacy policy as a control, and this requirement defines the measurable outcome.

qualityAttribute.suggestion: Please resolve issues found with the Complete, Singular, and/or Unambiguous attributes.
R5 - Contains indefinite article(s): [a]. Consider replacing with the definite article, "the."

entity.name: Verify Academic Task Data Handling
entity.description: Verify that StudyFlow receives and maintains the academic task information required for planning and replanning.

stringAttribute.value: Required task information is received, maintained, and retrievable without unintended modification.
Prepare representative task records containing deadlines, workload estimates, completion status, priorities, and preferences.

entity.name: Determine Available Study Slots
entity.description: The Study Slot Identification Module shall determine available study slots that satisfy the identified scheduling constraints.

stringAttribute.value: Draft
Available study slots must be determined from the identified scheduling constraints before prioritized tasks can be allocated to valid study periods.

entity.name: N-09 trace features to needs
entity.description: The Development Team needs every MVP feature to trace to an approved stakeholder need within a defined MVP boundary, because untraced or optional features consume limited project time.

entity.description: Students need to be told when their available time is not enough to complete all of their work, because they want to make tradeoffs before a deadline is missed.

stringAttribute.value: Diagnostic and feedback information enables the Development Team to reproduce defects, evaluate system behavior, and maintain the planning workflow.

qualityAttribute.suggestion: Please resolve issues found with the Complete, Singular, and/or Unambiguous attributes.

entity.name: Verify Study Plan Update and Presentation
entity.description: Verify that StudyFlow updates and presents the study plan using the latest saved planning information.

stringAttribute.value: The updated plan reflects the latest saved inputs, preserves completed work where applicable, and presents the revised plan correctly.
Generate an initial plan, then change representative task, workload, completion-status, deadline, or availability data.

entity.name: Verify Study Plan and Recommendation Output
entity.description: Verify that StudyFlow produces the required planning and prioritization outputs for representative planning scenarios.

stringAttribute.value: The Student can view the study plan and task-priority recommendation. Regeneration uses the latest saved inputs and displays the updated plan. On-page notifications report generation or update outcomes. When workload exceeds available study time, the page identifies unscheduled workload by task in minutes without placing study blocks outside the supplied availability. Scheduled smart reminders and external push, email, or SMS delivery are outside the MVP test scope.

Prepare valid tasks with known deadlines, remaining workload, priorities, preferences, and study availability. Generate a plan, then change a saved input and regenerate it. Repeat with total remaining workload exceeding the available study time; record the expected unscheduled workload by task in minutes. Inspect the Student-facing page after each operation.

entity.name: Accept Study Availability
entity.description: The StudyFlow System shall accept Study Availability from the Student.

stringAttribute.value: Draft
Study availability is required to create a feasible schedule that fits the student's actual available time and can be regenerated when availability changes.

entity.name: Verify Student Planning Input Interface
entity.description: Verify that the defined Student interface accepts the planning information required by StudyFlow.

stringAttribute.value: All required supported student planning inputs can be submitted through the defined interface.
Prepare representative task, deadline, workload, priority, availability, and preference inputs.

entity.name: Receive and Maintain Academic Task Data
Tasks, deadlines, workload estimates, priorities, user preferences
Planning outputs and workload shortfall
entity.description: Student-facing planning-output information package generated by F.1 and F.1.6 and received by F.2. It contains the current study plan, prioritized next-task recommendation and rationale, plan updates, and on-page notifications of planning outcomes. It explicitly includes workload shortfall: unscheduled remaining workload reported by task in minutes when supplied availability is insufficient. Notifications are limited to the current page in the MVP; scheduled smart reminders and external push, email, and SMS delivery are future capabilities.

entity.name: Verify Task Information Request Output
entity.description: Verify whether StudyFlow will request the required task information when it is missing.

stringAttribute.value: StudyFlow produces a clear request for the missing task information.
Start a representative planning workflow without required task information.

entity.name: Study Assistance Request and Context
entity.description: Canonical input information package for F.6 Provide Study Planning Assistance, generated by F.1/F.1.6 for the optional LLM Service. It includes the study-planning assistance request and the relevant task, deadline, workload, availability, and planning context. The abbreviated legacy label "Study Assistance" denotes this same information package. Use "Study Assistance Request and Context" consistently in the single-function and integrated IDEF0 diagrams and in requirement 1.2.5.

entity.name: Development / Support Team
entity.description: The team responsible for developing, maintaining, updating, troubleshooting, and supporting the StudyFlow system throughout its life cycle.

entity.name: External Service Independence
entity.description: The StudyFlow system shall perform requirements 1.4.1–1.4.6 when the Academic/LMS System, Calendar System, and LLM Service are unavailable.

stringAttribute.value: Draft
F.4–F.6 are optional future interfaces; core planning must not depend on them so the MVP stays inside its approved boundary.

qualityAttribute.suggestion: Please resolve issues found with the Complete, Singular, and/or Unambiguous attributes.
R37 - Contains undefined acronym(s) without "relates" relationship(s) to Acronym entities: [LMS, LLM]

entity.name: Accept Study‑planning requests, context information
entity.description: The StudyFlow System shall accept Study‑planning requests, context information from the Student.

stringAttribute.value: Draft
Planning requests and context initiate the guided planning workflow and provide the information needed to create or revise a study plan.

qualityAttribute.suggestion: Please resolve issues found with the Complete, Singular, and/or Unambiguous attributes.

entity.name: Verify LMS Data Request Interface
entity.description: Inspect the optional Academic/LMS interface and verify that data requests and synchronization exchanges are defined.

stringAttribute.value: Data-request and synchronization interactions are clearly specified as optional future interfaces.
Review the Academic/LMS interface specification.

entity.name: System updates, configuration changes, maintenance, support
Verify Calendar Event Interface
entity.description: Inspect the optional calendar interface and verify that existing events, schedules, and available-time information are consistently defined.

stringAttribute.value: Existing events, class schedules, and available study-time information are clearly specified as optional future inputs.

entity.name: Provide Study Calendar Updates
entity.description: The Feasible Plan Generation Subsystem shall provide Study Calendar Updates corresponding to the generated feasible study plan.

stringAttribute.value: Draft
Study Calendar Updates are an explicit boundary output of F.1.5.5 and must correspond to the generated plan.

entity.name: Study-planning requests, context information (optional)
entity.description: The StudyFlow System shall interface with the LLM Service through the Study-planning requests, context information (optional).

stringAttribute.value: Draft

qualityAttribute.suggestion: R21 - Potential additional information detected inside parentheses. Consider moving to Rationale.

stringAttribute.value: This interface provides structured planning context to an optional external LLM service and is not required for the core rule-based MVP workflow.

entity.name: Report workload shortfall
entity.description: The StudyFlow system shall identify tasks whose remaining workload cannot be scheduled before their deadlines and report the unscheduled workload in minutes without exceeding entered availability.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

qualityAttribute.suggestion: Not verified by a Requirement nor Test Case.
Please resolve issues found with the Complete, Singular, and/or Unambiguous attributes.

entity.name: Capture Study Availability
entity.description: The StudyFlow System shall enable the student to enter, revise, and save available study-time intervals for use as scheduling limits.

stringAttribute.value: Draft
StudyFlow must capture the student's available study time so that generated study sessions fit within realistic scheduling constraints.

qualityAttribute.suggestion: Please resolve issues found with the Complete, Singular, and/or Unambiguous attributes.

entity.name: Verify Student Planning Output Interface
entity.description: Verify that the defined Student interface can present StudyFlow planning outputs.

stringAttribute.value: The Student can receive the resulting study plan, priority recommendation, and applicable plan updates through the defined interface.
Execute a representative planning scenario using valid student data.

entity.name: Planning outputs and workload shortfall
entity.description: The StudyFlow System shall provide the Student with the Planning outputs and workload shortfall information package, containing the current study plan, task-priority recommendation and rationale, plan updates, on-page notifications of planning outcomes, and unscheduled workload by task in minutes. Scheduled smart reminders and external notification delivery are outside the current MVP scope.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

qualityAttribute.suggestion: R30 - Potential duplicate of: [1.2.7 Provide study plans, task-priority recommendations, on-page notifications, plan updates, and workload shortfall (84.8% similar), 1.4.6 Update and Present Study Plan (73.2% similar)]

stringAttribute.value: This interface delivers actionable study plans and priority recommendations to the student and supports plan updates when the student's academic situation changes.

qualityAttribute.suggestion: Please resolve issues found with the Complete, Singular, and/or Unambiguous attributes.
R37 - Contains undefined acronym(s) without "relates" relationship(s) to Acronym entities: [MVP]

entity.name: Verify Study Availability Capture
entity.description: Verify that StudyFlow correctly captures the student's entered study availability.

stringAttribute.value: Captured availability exactly matches the submitted intervals and is available for subsequent planning.
Enter representative availability intervals covering different days and time periods.

Study Availability Subsystem to Deadline and Workload Analysis Subsystem

entity.description: The Study Plan Assembly Module shall generate the feasible study plan and associated study-calendar updates from the feasibility assessment.

stringAttribute.value: Draft
The feasibility assessment must be converted into the final feasible study plan and associated study-calendar updates for downstream presentation.

entity.name: Accept Maintenance Updates and Configuration
entity.description: The StudyFlow System shall accept Maintenance Updates and Configuration from the Development / Support Team.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

qualityAttribute.suggestion: R30 - Potential duplicate of: [1.1.4 Accept Maintain traceability and scope (72.7% similar), 1.1.6 Accept Preserve saved data (72.7% similar), 1.1.7 Accept Protect student data (72.7% similar)]

stringAttribute.value: Controlled configuration and maintenance updates support independent component change while preserving the documented MVP architecture and scope.

qualityAttribute.suggestion: Please resolve issues found with the Complete, Singular, and/or Unambiguous attributes.

entity.name: Produce Repeatable Study Plans
entity.description: The Feasible Plan Generation Subsystem shall produce identical study-session allocations and workload-shortfall results for identical input data and planning-rule versions.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

Equivalence is selected because the repeatability criterion in system requirement 2.1.4 applies directly to the study-session allocations and workload-shortfall results produced by this subsystem. Recommendation outputs owned by other subsystems remain outside this allocation.

entity.name: N-02 fit workload into available time
entity.description: Students need their remaining workload divided into manageable study sessions that fit their available time and finish before each deadline, because unplanned work leads to last-minute cramming.

entity.name: Data Availability
entity.description: The StudyFlow system shall restore all successfully saved task and availability fields for the same student when the application is closed and reopened.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

qualityAttribute.suggestion: R26 - Potential use of absolutes detected: [all]

stringAttribute.value: Re-entering the week discourages continued use; 1.1.6 accepts the preservation policy, and this requirement defines the restoration outcome.

qualityAttribute.suggestion: Please resolve issues found with the Complete, Singular, and/or Unambiguous attributes.

entity.name: Initiate Study Plan Generation
entity.description: Enter Academic Task Information

entity.name: Scheduling Constraint Module / Study Slot Identification Module
Provide Feasible Study Plan
entity.description: The Feasible Plan Generation Subsystem shall provide the Feasible Study Plan produced from the feasibility assessment.

stringAttribute.value: Draft
The Feasible Study Plan crosses the subsystem boundary and provides the planning result for downstream presentation.

entity.name: Generate Study Plan Within Allocated Time
entity.description: The Feasible Plan Generation Subsystem shall make the initial or regenerated Feasible Study Plan, including study-session allocations and unscheduled workload by task in minutes, available for downstream presentation within 3.0 seconds after receiving the complete valid Prioritized Task Set.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

Apportionment is selected to divide the five-second end-to-end response-time target in system requirement 2.3.1. The proposed budget assigns 3.0 seconds to C.2.5, 1.0 second to preceding processing, 0.5 second to downstream processing and display, and 0.5 second to integration reserve. C.2.5 receives the largest share because it performs the five planning functions. These are draft design targets, not measured performance results. The same proposed three-second planning limit is applied to initial plan generation as a component contribution to the five-minute first-use workflow in requirement 2.1.1. The complete usability criterion still requires system-level evaluation of task entry, availability entry, and plan presentation.For requirement 2.1.1, Synthesis is used to derive the initial-planning time constraint as a component contribution to the complete first-use usability workflow.

entity.name: Feasible Plan Generation Subsystem to Study Plan Presentation Subsystem
Provide Optional Calendar Interface
entity.description: The Feasible Plan Generation Subsystem shall provide generated Study Calendar Updates to the Calendar System through the optional calendar interface when calendar integration is enabled.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

System requirement 1.3.9 defines the optional outbound Calendar System interface. The second-level IDEF0 assigns Study Calendar Updates to F.1.5.5. This component interface requirement identifies the external recipient and activation condition for the output covered by CR-8. Calendar integration remains outside the current MVP baseline.

entity.name: Accept Tasks, deadlines, workload estimates, priorities, user preferences
entity.description: The StudyFlow System shall accept Tasks, deadlines, workload estimates, priorities, user preferences from the Student.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

qualityAttribute.suggestion: R30 - Potential duplicate of: [1.3.2 Tasks, deadlines, workload estimates, priorities, availability, user preferences (95.0% similar), 1.4.1 Receive and Maintain Academic Task Data (84.4% similar), 1.4.6 Update and Present Study Plan (75.9% similar), 2.3.1 Response Time (71.3% similar)]

stringAttribute.value: Current task and workload information is required to create and regenerate plans using the student's latest academic inputs.

qualityAttribute.suggestion: Please resolve issues found with the Complete, Singular, and/or Unambiguous attributes.

entity.name: Verify LLM Request Interface
entity.description: Inspect the optional LLM interface and verify that study-planning requests and context information are defined.

stringAttribute.value: The planning request and context exchanged with the LLM are clearly defined without making the MVP dependent on the service.
Review the StudyFlow–LLM request interface specification.

entity.name: Testable and explainable planning
entity.description: The StudyFlow project shall document planning rules and their expected results and provide repeatable test cases that produce identical outputs from identical inputs and rule versions.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

qualityAttribute.suggestion: Not verified by a Requirement nor Test Case.
Please resolve issues found with the Complete, Singular, and/or Unambiguous attributes.

entity.name: Maintain Plan-to-Task Traceability
entity.description: The Feasible Plan Generation Subsystem shall retain the association between each scheduled study session and its originating academic task in the generated feasible study plan.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

Retaining the association between scheduled study sessions and their originating tasks supports the task-specific allocation and workload accounting required by system requirement 1.4.5. This is distinct from the requirements traceability and scope control addressed by CR-14.

entity.name: N-01 identify next task
entity.description: Students need to see which task to work on next, along with its deadline and remaining workload, because a deadline list alone does not show what to do now.

StudyFlow must calculate task priorities so that the student can identify what to work on next using documented and testable prioritization rules.

entity.name: Usability
entity.description: The StudyFlow system shall enable a first-time student to enter representative tasks and study availability and generate a valid initial study plan within 5 minutes without external assistance.

stringAttribute.value: Draft
Time spent learning the tool is time taken away from studying; functional tests of 1.4.1, 1.4.2 and 1.4.6 cannot show that a new student can complete them unaided.

entity.name: Verify Academic Information Input Definition
entity.description: Inspect the defined Academic/LMS input interface and verify that course information, assignments, exams, and deadlines are consistently specified.

stringAttribute.value: Course, assignment, exam, and deadline inputs are clearly defined and identified as an optional future interface.
Review the Academic/LMS interface definition and its academic-information input specification.

entity.name: Verify Explanatory Response Output
entity.description: Check the defined explanatory response output and verify whether it is significantly separated from the required core planning behavior.

stringAttribute.value: Explanations, study advice, and text responses are clearly defined as optional assistance.
Review the LLM-related output/interface definition.

entity.name: Verify Saved Data Preservation
entity.description: Verify that representative saved planning data can be preserved and retrieved without unintended modification.

stringAttribute.value: Saved task and availability information remains available and unchanged when retrieved in a later session.
Create representative task and availability records and save them in StudyFlow.

entity.name: Evaluate Schedule Feasibility
entity.description: The Schedule Feasibility Evaluation Module shall evaluate the proposed study sessions for compliance with the applicable scheduling constraints and identify any workload that cannot be scheduled.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

Proposed study sessions must be evaluated for compliance with applicable scheduling constraints so that scheduling violations and unscheduled workload can be identified before the final plan is assembled.

entity.name: N-03 update plan after changes
entity.description: Students need their plan to update when a task, deadline, workload estimate, completion status, or availability changes, because their week rarely goes as planned.

entity.name: Planning Repeatability
entity.description: The StudyFlow system shall produce identical next-task recommendations, rationales, study-session allocations, and workload-shortfall results for identical inputs and planning-rule versions.

stringAttribute.value: Draft
The rule-based solution was selected because it is consistent and testable; repeatable outputs allow defects to be reproduced.

qualityAttribute.suggestion: Please resolve issues found with the Complete, Singular, and/or Unambiguous attributes.

entity.name: System updates, configuration changes, maintenance, support
entity.description: The StudyFlow System shall interface with the Development / Support Team through the System updates, configuration changes, maintenance, support.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

qualityAttribute.suggestion: R30 - Potential duplicate of: [1.3.7 System logs, performance data, error reports, user feedback (77.0% similar), 1.2.8 Provide System logs, performance data, error reports, user feedback (73.1% similar)]

stringAttribute.value: This interface supports controlled system maintenance and configuration changes while preserving component independence and the approved MVP scope.

qualityAttribute.suggestion: Please resolve issues found with the Complete, Singular, and/or Unambiguous attributes.

entity.name: Tasks, deadlines, workload estimates, priorities, availability, user preferences
Verify Academic Task Input
entity.description: Verify that StudyFlow accepts the academic task information required for planning.

stringAttribute.value: All required supported task fields are accepted correctly without omission or unintended modification.
Prepare representative tasks with deadlines, workload estimates, priorities, and user preferences.

entity.name: Verify Student Data Protection
entity.description: Verify that access to representative student planning data follows the documented access-control rules.

stringAttribute.value: Authorized access succeeds and unauthorized access to protected student information is rejected.
Prepare representative student data and authorized and unauthorized access scenarios.

entity.name: Generate Plans Independently of External Services
entity.description: The Feasible Plan Generation Subsystem shall generate the feasible study plan and associated study-calendar updates from valid manually supplied planning inputs when the Academic/LMS System, Calendar System, and LLM Service are unavailable.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

Equivalence is selected because system requirement 2.3.4 requires continued operation of functions 1.4.1 through 1.4.6 when the optional external services are unavailable. This subsystem carries the same independence constraint for its allocated function, 1.4.5. Generating study-calendar updates does not require delivering them to an unavailable Calendar System.

entity.name: Perform StudyFlow System Mission
entity.description: The StudyFlow System shall transform student-entered academic task data and study availability into an actionable, rule-based study plan and prioritized next-task recommendation, and shall update the plan when saved inputs change.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

qualityAttribute.suggestion: Not verified by a Requirement nor Test Case.

entity.name: Verify Study-Planning Request Input
entity.description: Verify that StudyFlow accepts the planning request and associated context required to begin the planning workflow.

stringAttribute.value: The planning request and required context are successfully accepted for processing.
Prepare representative planning requests with valid context information.

entity.name: Provide Study Calendar Updates
entity.description: The StudyFlow System shall provide Study Calendar Updates to the Calendar System.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

qualityAttribute.suggestion: R30 - Potential duplicate of: [1.1.1 Accept Calendar Events and Busy Times (74.1% similar)]

stringAttribute.value: Calendar updates support a possible future synchronization capability but are not required for the current manually managed MVP workflow.

entity.name: Preserve Student Data Separation
entity.description: The Feasible Plan Generation Subsystem shall exclude records belonging to other students from the Feasible Study Plan and Study Calendar Updates generated for a student under the documented user-access model.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

Synthesis is selected to derive an output-data separation obligation from system requirement 2.1.3. C.2.5 must prevent cross-student data mixing in its planning outputs. Authentication and delivery to the authorized student remain responsibilities of the surrounding system.

entity.name: Preserve saved data
entity.description: The StudyFlow system shall restore successfully saved task and availability records when the same student reopens the application.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

qualityAttribute.suggestion: Not verified by a Requirement nor Test Case.
Please resolve issues found with the Complete, Singular, and/or Unambiguous attributes.

entity.name: System logs, performance data, error reports, user feedback
Accept Traceability and Scope Control
entity.description: The Feasible Plan Generation Subsystem shall accept the traceability and scope control applicable to study-plan generation.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

System requirement 1.1.4 establishes traceability and scope control to keep implemented functionality linked to approved stakeholder needs and prevent uncontrolled scope growth. This control is inherited by F.1.5.5 and must be represented in the component specification. It is distinct from the plan-to-task association required by CR-10.

entity.name: Calendar System
entity.description: An external calendar service that may provide student availability and scheduled events and may receive recommended study sessions from StudyFlow.

entity.name: Maintainability
entity.description: The StudyFlow system shall separate the user interface, planning logic, and data storage through documented component interfaces so that the planning logic can be tested without the user interface or persistent store.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

qualityAttribute.suggestion: R31 - Potentially imposes software solution: [component, interface, interfaces]

stringAttribute.value: Isolated components allow one part to change without forcing changes in the others, reduce regression risk, and allow planning rules to be tested on their own.

qualityAttribute.suggestion: Please resolve issues found with the Complete, Singular, and/or Unambiguous attributes.

entity.name: Provide Academic Information Request
entity.description: The StudyFlow System shall provide an Academic Information Request to the Academic / LMS System.

stringAttribute.value: Draft
The request supports the planned LMS interface, but automated LMS integration is outside the approved MVP baseline.

qualityAttribute.suggestion: Please resolve issues found with the Complete, Singular, and/or Unambiguous attributes.
R5 - Contains indefinite article(s): [an]. Consider replacing with the definite article, "the."
R37 - Contains undefined acronym(s) without "relates" relationship(s) to Acronym entities: [LMS]

entity.name: Update and Present Study Plan
entity.description: The StudyFlow System shall present the current study plan, next-task recommendation with rationale, and any workload shortfall, and regenerate the displayed plan whenever saved task, deadline, workload, completion-status, or availability data change.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

qualityAttribute.suggestion: R30 - Potential duplicate of: [2.3.1 Response Time (84.6% similar), 1.3.2 Tasks, deadlines, workload estimates, priorities, availability, user preferences (80.0% similar), 1.4.1 Receive and Maintain Academic Task Data (76.8% similar), 1.1.10 Accept Tasks, deadlines, workload estimates, priorities, user preferences (75.9% similar), 1.3.1 Planning outputs and workload shortfall (73.2% similar)]

stringAttribute.value: StudyFlow must present the generated plan and update it when relevant planning inputs change so that recommendations remain current and actionable for the student.

qualityAttribute.suggestion: Please resolve issues found with the Complete, Singular, and/or Unambiguous attributes.
R32 - Contains universal qualifier(s): [any]. Consider replacing with the universal quantifier, "each."

entity.name: Use StudyFlow Services
entity.description: 代表学生使用 StudyFlow 来完成学术任务和学习安排、请求学习计划、查看建议和提交进度更新。

entity.name: Receive and Maintain Academic Task Data
entity.description: The StudyFlow System shall enable the student to create, revise, and save academic task records containing task identity, deadline, estimated workload, priority, and completion status for use in planning.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

qualityAttribute.suggestion: R30 - Potential duplicate of: [1.3.2 Tasks, deadlines, workload estimates, priorities, availability, user preferences (85.2% similar), 1.1.10 Accept Tasks, deadlines, workload estimates, priorities, user preferences (84.4% similar), 1.4.6 Update and Present Study Plan (76.8% similar), 2.3.1 Response Time (72.1% similar)]

stringAttribute.value: StudyFlow must maintain current academic task information so that planning and replanning use the latest deadlines, workload estimates, completion status, priorities, and preferences.

qualityAttribute.suggestion: Please resolve issues found with the Complete, Singular, and/or Unambiguous attributes.

entity.name: Verify Calendar Event Input Definition
entity.description: Inspect the defined calendar input interface and verify that calendar events and busy-time information are specified consistently as an optional future input.

stringAttribute.value: Calendar events and busy-time inputs are clearly defined, consistently represented, and identified as an optional future interface outside the current MVP baseline.
Review the StudyFlow Calendar System interface definition and the Calendar Events and Busy Times input specification.

entity.name: Preserve Saved Data
entity.description: The Feasible Plan Generation Subsystem shall preserve existing saved data during study-plan generation.

stringAttribute.value: Draft

Synthesis is selected to derive a data-preservation constraint from system requirement 2.3.2. Plan generation must preserve existing saved information needed for subsequent restoration. Storage and restoration after application reopening remain responsibilities of the components that own persistence. This requirement also reflects the inherited data-preservation control identified by system requirement 1.1.6.

entity.name: Proposed study sessions, calendar updates (optional)
entity.description: The StudyFlow System shall interface with the Calendar System through the Proposed study sessions, calendar updates (optional).

stringAttribute.value: Draft

qualityAttribute.suggestion: R21 - Potential additional information detected inside parentheses. Consider moving to Rationale.

stringAttribute.value: This interface defines a future calendar synchronization capability for proposed study sessions, but calendar integration is outside the current MVP baseline.

qualityAttribute.suggestion: Please resolve issues found with the Complete, Singular, and/or Unambiguous attributes.

entity.name: Verify LMS Academic Data Interface
entity.description: Inspect the optional Academic/LMS interface and verify that required academic data elements are defined.

stringAttribute.value: Course, assignment, exam, and deadline information are clearly and consistently defined.
Review the LMS academic-data interface definition.

entity.name: Verify Core Planning Without External Services
Verify LLM Response Input Definition
entity.description: Inspect the optional LLM response interface and verify that explanations, study advice, and text responses are clearly defined.

stringAttribute.value: LLM responses are clearly specified and do not create a dependency for the core MVP planning workflow.
Review the StudyFlow–LLM interface and the defined response information.

entity.name: Verify Calendar Update Interface
entity.description: Inspect the optional calendar interface and verify that proposed study sessions and calendar-update information are defined.

stringAttribute.value: Proposed study-session and calendar-update information are clearly defined as optional future interface elements.
Review the StudyFlow–Calendar output/interface specification.

entity.name: Allocate Prioritized Tasks
entity.description: The Task Allocation Module shall allocate prioritized tasks into available study slots to generate proposed study sessions.

stringAttribute.value: Draft
Prioritized tasks must be allocated into available study slots to transform scheduling capacity and task information into proposed study sessions.
